title: A Brief History of Shan Script and Literature (ပိုၼ်းၵႅပ်းလိၵ်ႈလၢႆးတႆး)
author: Lung Sai Fah (လုင်းၸၢႆးၾႃႈ)
description: Authoritative historical study by Tai epigrapher Lung Sai Fah on the chronological development of Tai scripts, from the archaic Lik To-Ngo and Lik To-Mao circular scripts of Upper Burma and Yunnan through palm-leaf religious transmission to modern print typography, demonstrating direct genetic relationships with the Tai Khamyang and Ahom orthographic systems.

sentences.text_roman: pün kep lik lai tai pen pün tu lik kaw

sentences.free_translation_en: A Brief History of Shan Script and Literature is a rigorous study of ancient Tai orthography.

sentences.speaker: Lung Sai Fah
